sources.label: Patches for the Wykop.pl app, for use with Morphe
sources.author: HagiaHaya
patch_list: Allows signing in with Google by using MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services.
Removes the ads shown between deals and on the deal pages.
Opens the store page of a deal directly, instead of through redirects that track the click and add affiliate links.
Shares the direct link to deals and discussions, instead of a link that redirects through a tracking service.

Adds a setting to show Silver, Gold or Platinum in the app, such as on the profile, instead of the contributor level earned. It unlocks the app icons of the level, but rewards granted by Pepper, such as more deal stats, are not unlocked.
Unlocks all app icons regardless of the contributor level, and offers the seasonal icons, such as the Black Friday one, all year round.
